attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/numeric-record-ordering/bin/merge. It now performs numeric transaction ordering, preserves quoted CSV fields, emits one header, collapses identical duplicates, rejects conflicting duplicates with diagnostics, and publishes atomically so failed merges preserve the existing output. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged. The repair persisted across the required node restart.
